title: The Episode About Baba Banda And Bahadur Shah S

blocks.text: The imperial advance now stretches through the Panipat-Karnal-Taravardi line, while Banda tests and harasses the movement from multiple points rather than simply waiting to be crushed.
The page emphasizes the spread of his standard and the recovery of revenue and territory, showing a campaign that is both mobile and administrative.
Panipat becomes the strongest geographic anchor here, marking how far the theater has widened under Banda’s pressure.
